summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only e2e test of Træningsmester pre-launch v3 (clean black/white/electric-blue aesthetic + Three.js 3D phone + Matter.js plate playground). 13/13 user-listed checklist items PASS. The design is now genuinely clean — only 1 gradient element remains across the whole DOM (a subtle radial shadow under the 3D phone); the 'unicorn vomit' rainbow gradients are gone. Both showoff set-pieces work: the 3D iPhone renders, auto-rotates, and reacts to mouse drag; the physics playground drops kg plates with gravity, the live total updates (95kg→100kg on add, back to 95kg on reset), and dragging a plate visibly changes the canvas. Hero waitlist writes to real Supabase (201 OK). Mobile 390 is overflow-free at all scroll positions; the giant footer wordmark fits on one line; pillars unpin/stack on mobile; plate-stage on mobile is scrollable past (touch drag disabled by design via pointer:fine — verified). Two MINOR issues only: (1) cookie banner UX persistence not visually confirmed in this run because the OK button was not always clickable beneath the legal panel during the regression sub-test, and (2) the mobile footer wordmark element has a 1px sub-pixel inner overflow (scrollW=351 vs clientW=350) — visually fine and the parent is 390. Not blockers.

issues: 1px inner sub-pixel overflow: .footer-word scrollWidth=351 vs clientWidth=350 (font-size 40.9px). Parent is 390 — no visible clipping. Could be eliminated by useFitText shrinking 1 more step.

console_observations: ERROR (NOT app bug): Cloudflare beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) blocked by CSP 'script-src self unsafe-inline' — this is injected by the Emergent preview proxy, not the app. No action needed.
WARNING (benign): WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' — caused by our test calling gl.readPixels() to measure canvas activity, not by app code.
WARNING (benign): 'Canvas2D: Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with willReadFrequently' — caused by our pixel-signature probe on the plate canvas, not by app code.
No Three.js, Matter.js, or app-side JS errors in console during the entire run.
action_items: NONE BLOCKING. Optional: useFitText shrink one more step so the mobile footer-word's own scrollWidth (351) ≤ clientWidth (350) (currently 1px sub-pixel overflow, not visually clipped).
Optional: main.tsx is large (~1500+ lines) — split into per-section modules per code-review guideline (>700 lines) for maintainability (not user-facing).
critical_code_review_comments: Phone3D.tsx creates the WebGLRenderer without preserveDrawingBuffer:true — this is the correct default and a tiny perf win, but means automated pixel readback for tests requires an explicit screenshot rather than gl.readPixels. Not a bug.
Phone3D.tsx attaches pointermove on window (passive: true) and only initiates drag on canvas pointerdown — clean and prevents accidental drag-scroll on the rest of the page. Good.
PlatePlayground.tsx correctly gates Matter.MouseConstraint behind window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches so touch devices retain page scrolling. Verified in mobile run.

Waitlist form still relies on adding noValidate at runtime for automated tests to reach the app-level Danish error message; in real users this means typing 'abc' will surface the browser's native 'Please include an @' English popup INSTEAD of the friendlier Danish 'Skriv en gyldig emailadresse.' Consider adding noValidate to the <form> element directly so users see the Danish copy.
main.tsx >700 lines — should be split per code-review guideline (carried over from iter_2).
